underlying_goal: Modify the Oh My Copilot CLI project to use correct global (~/.copilot/) and project-local (.github/) paths for agents and hooks, aligned with official Copilot documentation
friction_detail: Initial implementation moved hooks to global ~/.copilot/hooks/ which Copilot doesn't officially support; also had a type error from function signature change without updating callers.
brief_summary: User asked to refactor OMC CLI paths from project-local to global ~/.copilot/ paths; initial implementation was done but analysis revealed hooks needed a hybrid approach (global scripts + project-local hooks.json), leading to an iterative revised plan.
